app.name: NutriCart
welcome.title: Follow someone's day
welcome.intro: Ask them for the 6-character code shown in NutriCart under Settings → Cloud sync, and enter it here. You will see what they eat as they log it, and you can send a nudge.
welcome.name: Your name (they will see it)
welcome.bad_code: That code does not work. Codes last 15 minutes and work once; ask for a new one.
welcome.too_many: Too many tries. Wait ten minutes and ask for a fresh code.
welcome.not_configured: This site has no cloud keys configured.
day.title: {name}'s day
nudge.title: Send a nudge
nudge.sent: Sent. It shows on the phone within 15 minutes, or at once if the app is open.
nudge.failed: Could not send. Are you still linked?
week.title: Last 7 days
week.no_data: No data for these days yet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your name
settings.signout_hint: Removes your anonymous account from this browser. The accounts you follow keep their data.
settings.privacy: You see only what the account owner shares: meal names and calories, water, weight and daily activity totals. They can remove your access at any time from their phone.
welcome.track_intro: No Android phone? Use NutriCart here: the same calorie math, food search and diary, in the browser. Add it to your Home Screen for an app-like experience.
ob.title: About you
ob.birth_hint: Your age is part of the calorie formula.
ob.act.SEDENTARY: Sedentary: little or no exercise, desk work
ob.act.ACTIVE: Active: hard exercise 6–7 times a week
ob.act.VERY_ACTIVE: Very active: physical job plus regular training
ob.floor_note: Your target was raised to the safe minimum.
ob.note: This is an estimate for guidance, not medical advice.
me.title: My day
me.macros: Protein {p} g · Fat {f} g · Carbs {c} g
add.title: Add to {meal}
add.offline: Could not reach Open Food Facts.
add.scan_hint: Point the camera at the barcode.
add.scan_unsupported: Camera scanning is not available in this browser.
settings.account_signed_in: Signed in as {email}. Your phone and this browser share one account.
settings.account_hint: Add an email to open this account on another device and keep it if you lose this one. Already use NutriCart on your phone? Sign in with the email you linked there.
settings.account_sent: Confirmation sent to {email}. Open the link in that email on this device.
settings.account_magic_sent: Sign-in link sent to {email}. Open it on this device.
settings.account_unknown: No account has that email yet. Link it on your phone under Settings → Cloud sync, or choose Keep this account here.
settings.account_error: Could not send the email. Check the address and try again.
settings.signout_hint_email: Signs this browser out. Your data stays in the account; sign in again with your email.

settings.profile_phone: This profile is managed in the NutriCart app on your phone. Change it there; the website follows.

settings.share_hint: Make a code and have your partner enter it on this website under "Follow someone’s day". They will see what you eat as you log it and can send you a nudge.
